title: Utility Line Protection Plans: Covered Causes, Parts and Exclusions by Plan
content:
# Covered Causes, Parts and Exclusions by Plan

For the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans, this schedule records which causes of failure and which parts each plan covers, and the conditions and parts each plan never covers.

## Causes and parts covered (Yes means covered)

| Plan | Lead service line replacement | Work ordered by the utility or a government program | Failure caused by freezing | Blockage or break caused by tree roots | Main water shutoff valve | Electrical meter base and weatherhead | Clearing an interior drain stoppage | Backflow preventer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan | No | No | Yes | No | Yes | No | No | No |
| Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | No | No | No | No | No | Yes | No | No |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan | No | No | Yes | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |

Column meanings: whether replacing a lead service line is covered; whether work ordered by the utility or a government program, rather than caused by a failure, is covered; whether failures caused by freezing are covered; whether blockages and breaks caused by tree roots are covered; whether the homeowner's main water shutoff valve is covered; whether the electrical meter base and weatherhead are covered; whether clearing an interior drain stoppage is covered; whether backflow preventers are covered.

## Conditions and parts never covered

| Plan | Excluded conditions and parts |
|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan | the utility-owned side; replacement of a lead line mandated by the utility or a program; damage by digging or construction; private hydrants and irrigation |
| Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | the utility-owned side; solar and generator interconnects; damage by digging or construction; an underground feed beyond the meter pole |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan | the utility-owned side; a backup from the public main; damage by digging or construction; the septic tank and drain field |
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | fixtures and faucets; appliance supply hoses; water damage to contents; the sewer lateral outside the foundation |
| Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | the utility-owned side; replacement of a lead line mandated by the utility or a program; a backup from the public main; the septic tank and drain field |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | the utility-owned side; replacement of a lead line mandated by the utility or a program; a backup from the public main; the septic tank and drain field; fixtures and faucets |

## Points read from the tables

- No plan covers lead service line replacement, utility- or program-ordered work, or backflow preventers.
- Tree-root damage is covered on every plan except the Exterior Water Service Line Plan and the Exterior Electrical Line Plan.
- Freezing is covered on every plan except the Exterior Electrical Line Plan.
